directive_basis: R404 item 9: CLAIM -> SOURCE -> EVIDENCE_CLASS -> VERIFICATION -> UNKNOWN -> EXPERIMENT for every important claim; a buyer can inspect why every important sentence exists.
scope: The important claims as they stand in the buyer sequence + canonical records. Every UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN (Art. XXV); no claim is promoted by documentation.

rows.claim: Posture change imposes a hydrostatic pressure step up to ~37 mmHg across a CSF shunt
rows.source: EQ-1 in the frozen equation registry (dP = rho*g*dh)
rows.verification: governing equation recorded in the package
rows.unknown: whether TRANSIENTS (vs steady over-drainage) carry distinct clinical harm — the premise itself is a recorded open question (Art. XX)
rows.experiment: clinical literature review / registry study (owner); NOT the bench experiment's role

rows.verification: mechanistically coherent + recorded equations; NOT demonstrated performance (Art. XLVII discipline)
